answer: No. All cited signals and customer feedback come from the EU (SIG-F70-EU-022, SIG-F70-EU-025) and specific EU feedback/study show the boot feels too small (hybrid battery impact), tailgate reliability issues, and missing internal shut button — so this is clearly not a US-only issue. Only limited evidence notes acceptable trunk space in one EU feedback item (EV-F70-EU-FB-F70-1039), but overall the EU signals and study (EV-F70-EU-ST-29) support addressing the requirement globally or at least for EU variants.
